review_text: Voice input stops mid-sentence when I switch to Hindi. Very frustrating when I'm trying to explain something in Hinglish.
App doesn't understand my accent at all. I speak Marathi-English mix and it just gives random text.
Voice works okay but I can't edit what it transcribed. I have to delete everything and type again.
When I use voice to ask a long question, it cuts off after 10 seconds. Can't complete my thought.
Tried using voice for my exam prep but the transcript had so many errors I gave up and typed everything.
No way to go back and fix just one word in the voice transcript. All or nothing.
Voice feature is hidden. Took me 3 days to find it. Should be more visible on the main screen.
It records my voice but then nothing happens. Just shows a blank response. Bug?
I speak Bengali-English and the app keeps switching languages mid-transcription. Very confusing output.
Would be great if I could select just part of the transcript and redo only that part with voice.
Voice cuts out in noisy environments like my college canteen. No noise cancellation at all.
I recorded a 2 minute voice note for a complex question. App crashed and lost everything.
The voice button disappears after I send one message. Have to reload the page to use it again.
Transcript is shown too fast. I can't read and verify before it auto-submits.
Using voice on 4G is unreliable. Works perfectly on WiFi but fails 50% on mobile data.
No confirmation step after voice input. It just sends whatever it heard, even if it's wrong.
I want to attach a photo of my textbook and then describe it by voice. Can't do both together.
Voice works but only for short queries. Anything longer than 30 seconds gets cut.
Telugu-English mixing causes the worst transcription errors. My friends have same problem.
App charges subscription but basic voice accuracy is worse than free alternatives. Very disappointing..
